byte_ledger.budget_provenance: RULED Advisor+Head 2026-08-13 as '≈2 MB'; implemented as the 2 MiB ceiling 2,097,152 B on the Hub's recommendation (CLU d=12 1,966,080 B = 0.94x; TTT-Linear 1,597,440 B = 0.76x). ⚠⚠ INTERIM AND BINDS NOTHING YET (Head+Advisor 2026-08-13): the ceiling digit is set in the RIVAL-LADDER PREREG, when the C3 CLU arm's store geometry is frozen — the pilot geometry is NOT presumed to be the C3 geometry. Until that prereg is filed no rival-ladder arm may train. ⛔ NO DTYPE NORMALISATION: NONE. RULED Head+Advisor 2026-08-13: the convention is TOTAL STATE BYTES AS DEPLOYED — an fp32 store pays its real 2x cost against a bf16 rival, and our arms ARE fp32 while the published-rival table is bf16. ⛔ This is NOT a bug: harder-for-us is the defensible direction of a matched-bytes control, so dtype_bytes is a DECLARED field of every row and never a conversion factor. Do not 'fix' this by normalising widths. See chlu/eval/byte_ledger.py INTERIM_MATCHED_STATE_BYTE_BUDGET.

readings.name: overdamping
readings.band: rho_conv <= 1e-06 and delta >= 0.02 (doctrine S2b)

detail.false_trip_mode: flat minima => tiny |grad V(q0)| => rho_conv is noise (denominator floored)

readings.name: settle_argmin
readings.band: rho_ex >= 0.1; D <= U by Prop D1; INAPPLICABLE if U < 0.01

detail.false_trip_mode: a genuinely tight query law puts all mass inside the balls => U -> 0 => 0/0
detail.note: no restoring verb: this monitor ESCALATES, never acts

readings.name: vacuous_gate
readings.band: fire-rate f in (0,1) strictly; C3 calibration rho_C3 in [1/3,3] and P[Delta>3B] <= 0.10 (C2W3 D3; the corr leg is RETIRED to a diagnostic); n_live/N_pack <= 0.95 (N74/N91); SC-3 deficit_rel <= B when the soft certificate is on

detail.validity_corr_domain: valid only for d/s >~ 4; the gym runs at d/s ~ 1.9-2

c3_calibration_leg.why: fewer than 3 qualifying pairs (lambda_min <= floor => the site is not a minimum => #8-N3's trip, not this one's)

detail.false_trip_mode: genuinely well-separated proposals give f=0 legitimately (leg ii must agree)

readings.name: blank
readings.band: acc_blank < chance + 3*se, chance = empirical marginal (N68/N110)

detail.false_trip_mode: a skewed marginal label distribution makes 1/K the wrong bar (chance is empirical)

readings.name: addressing
readings.band: acq >= 0.9 (chance 1/K); w19 violation 0.042

detail.false_trip_mode: an item deliberately decayed below the amp floor self-probes badly (excluded)

readings.name: objective_divergence
readings.band: sign agreement over 3 windows (w25/w26 violation), dead-band eps = 1e-09 * max|loss| (gym R2), eps_acq = 1e-09 * max|acq| (fb4 R4)

readings.name: mass_gauge
readings.band: pytest gauge: trajectory-wise invariance, Newtonian exact; relativistic breaks as O(1/c^2) (SCOPE, not a pass)

detail.why: gauge test runs in pytest (test_monitors.py), not in the stream
detail.false_trip_mode: endpoint-only comparison passes vacuously once both runs settle (compare trajectories)

readings.name: certificates
readings.band: N1 injective; N2 sep/sigma_q >= 5.15; N3 lambda_min > 0; N4 gap/(2*delta_read) >= 1 (doctrine R1)

detail.false_trip_mode: a declared register/coset shares a site by design => N1 fires (exempt declared cosets)

readings.name: lifetimes
readings.band: Delta_ret <= 0.1 (effect size, doctrine R4); corr reported as direction only

detail.known_uncleanable: at large excursion the fix is C1W27 gated stiffness
detail.false_trip_mode: items with deliberately different leak_i show intended spread (group within a leak cohort)

readings.name: dead_axis
readings.band: every DECLARED knob is read at least once; each swept knob moves an observable

readings.name: reach
readings.band: a_U - |a_i| > 0 for every live item (saddle criterion, 0 free params)

detail.false_trip_mode: single-well criterion: no neighbour term => mis-flags crowded cells (pair with #12 above 80% utilisation)

readings.name: starvation
readings.band: fairness >= 0.5; C3 ratio <= 2x the first-order bound; oldest-item retention drop <= 0.1

detail.false_trip_mode: an intentional update of an already-live item looks like starvation (exempt same-id writes)

readings.name: maturity
readings.band: write_steps >= 40 to PROMOTE a reading (N94)

detail.false_trip_mode: n/a — not a trip

provenance.note: readings below the maturity threshold may be logged, never promoted to a band statement

readings.name: guard_liveness
readings.band: every designed guard fires >= once on the canary stream

detail.false_trip_mode: a guard that the canary stream does not exercise (canary must be constructed to require each)

readings.name: launch_collapse
readings.band: S_marg = exp(H(p_bar)) >= 0.5 * N_a (marginal well usage across the batch)
